notes.title: She and the Light Bearer Trading Cards Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/67081f58fe8e8eed618824d02fd2ac16451bccb0.png[/img]

Hello, Light Bearers!

Long time no see! How are you all? We hope you’re all safe and healthy.

We are truly happy to announce that She and the Light Bearer trading cards are now available on Steam! Now whenever you play the game, you will be able to unlock and earn profile backgrounds, trading cards, and emoticons that you can use on Steam chat. Yay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/3554bc137cf37ebfc1099cf91641a8b7074b3684.gif[/img]

You will be able to collect a set of eight unique cards featuring Little Firefly and their forest friends, and craft them into upgradable She and the Light Bearer game badges that you can display on your Steam profile. We hope you love them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/843f31c42490b30ffa89616c9fc2930a0016e1a6.jpg[/img]

Oh, and another good news!

We will release another game called [b]When the Past was Around[/b] also by us, Mojiken Studio and Toge Productions, coming 22nd September 2020.

Check out the trailer here:
https://youtu.be/0Ayvr0pILnU

And don’t forget to wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164050/When_The_Past_Was_Around/

Thank you very much for you support for She and the Light Bearer!

Please stay safe!

- - - - -

Follow us on Twitter!
http://twitter.com/mojikenstudio

Join the community!
http://discord.gg/toge

notes.title: Здравствуйте! She and the Light Bearer Now Available in Russian
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, dear Light Bearers![/h3]

If you notice, we have an update for the game a while ago, and some of you might be wondering what was the update about.

We are happy to announce that [b]She and the Light Bearer[/b] now has Russian in the language option! She and the Light Bearer теперь доступна и на русском языке! We hope this will let more people enjoy the story of Firefly's journey with the help of forest friends to find Mother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/dc7ac84a58d1af11f881e7b290e8bd4f2a76cff8.png[/img]

And we want to thank our beloved Light Bearer, Solomon, for translating the game into Russian! Solomon has been very helpful to us and glad to have him as part of our community.

[h3]Have a wonderful day, Light Bearers![/h3]
